command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP 1: write logrotate config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app >/dev/null <<'EOF'
/var/log/inventory/app.log {
    daily
    rotate 7
    compress
    missingok
    notifempty
    copytruncate
}
EOF
cat /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app

echo "== STEP 2: syntax check via debug dry-run =="
sudo -n logrotate -d /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app 2>&1

echo "== STEP 3: baseline log content/inode =="
stat -c '%i %s' /var/log/inventory/app.log
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log

echo "== STEP 4: force rotation to prove it works end-to-end =="
sudo -n logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app --state /tmp/logrotate-inventory.state 2>&1

echo "== STEP 5: verify post-rotation state =="
ls -la /var/log/inventory/
echo "-- new app.log content (should be empty, file preserved for continued writes) --"
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log
echo "-- rotated file compressed? --"
ls /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz && zcat /var/log/inventory/app.log.1.gz

echo "== STEP 6: simulate app continuing to write post-rotation =="
echo "inventory service resumed writing after rotation" | sudo -n tee -a /var/log/inventory/app.log >/dev/null
cat /var/log/inventory/app.log
stat -c '%i' /var/log/inventory/app.log

echo "== STEP 7: run again to confirm 7-rotation retention config holds (second forced rotation) =="
sudo -n logrotate -f /etc/logrotate.d/inventory-app --state /tmp/logrotate-inventory.state 2>&1
ls -la /var/log/inventory/
